name: @thirdlight/workspace
description: Thirdlight durable workspace service (docs/contracts/workspace.md, M1): the sole command executor (runCommand — the full commands.md §6.1 pipeline: project resolution, deduplication, pause check, applyMutation steps 4–6, durable write, publish, acknowledge), the atomic authoring-state envelope, the atomic write/recovery protocol (temp/flush/replace/directory-flush/verify), ownership (claim + verification re-read, stale detection, explicit takeover), unexpected-external-change handling (snapshot/pause/accept/discard), project creation, and the startup scan.
